notes: Category-to-fix mapping for LARA. Cross-references analysis/error_categories.json by category_code. Each category lists one or more candidate fixes, ranked implicitly by tractability×fit. Status field tracks whether each fix has been applied. tractability scale: 5 = prompt-only additive change, 3 = prompt rewrite or single orchestrator behavior change, 1 = multi-file or contract-changing. Surface keys: explorer_prompt, venmo_specialist, phone_specialist, gmail_specialist, spotify_specialist, amazon_specialist, file_system_specialist, executor_react_prompt, orchestrator_guard, orchestrator_recovery, bootstrap_helpers.

fixes.description: Add explicit antipattern warnings naming the wrong API and pointing to the right one (e.g. 'NEVER use show_contact_relationships to get people; use search_contacts(relationship=...).').
fixes.applied_in_change: prompts.py SEMANTIC API SELECTION — group-vs-singular contact rule
fixes.rationale: Prompt-only; the wrong API names are stable across runs so we can enumerate them.

fixes.description: Add to OUTPUT FORMAT: every plan step must use concrete kwargs (no '<once identified>', no empty strings, no future-tense). Plans with placeholder language are rejected and re-prompted.
fixes.rationale: The model isn't aware that placeholders cause downstream fabrication. Explicit rule + concrete examples should help.

fixes.description: Detect placeholder patterns in the plan ('(once identified)', empty-string args) and force re-planning before dispatching to Executor.
fixes.rationale: Stronger guarantee but requires plan inspection in the supervisor.

fixes.description: Update the group-lookup pattern to ALWAYS use the singular kwarg ('roommate' not 'roommates'), and include both concrete examples + a 'NEVER pluralize the relationship value' rule.
fixes.rationale: The current prompt uses a <singular> placeholder; the model occasionally writes the plural form anyway.

fixes.description: Wrap search_contacts via a helper that auto-singularizes relationship= values, so plural plans still work.
fixes.rationale: Defensive — handles the case at runtime even if the plan slips up. More invasive.

fixes.description: Add to SEMANTIC API SELECTION: ANY task referencing a group word (roommate/coworker/friend/sibling/parent) MUST include a phone search_contacts(relationship=...) step. List the group words explicitly.
fixes.rationale: Same surface as the group-vs-singular rule. Already partially landed; may need strengthening.

fixes.description: Add a TIME-RELATIVE WINDOWS pattern block requiring two separate plan steps: (a) phone get_current_date_and_time computes absolute YYYY-MM-DD strings, (b) the next app step CONSUMES those strings via min_created_at / max_created_at kwargs.
fixes.rationale: Prompt-only, additive. Solves the cross-app contamination where venmo/gmail steps fall back to datetime.now().

fixes.description: Add a VENMO PATTERNS block disambiguating: 'payments I received' (past tense, settled transactions) → show_transactions(direction='received'); 'payment requests' (pending, awaiting approval) → show_received_payment_requests. List the action verbs that distinguish them.
fixes.rationale: Highest priority outstanding fix (priority A in 2026-05-22 prioritization, score 35 under safety-driven weights). Solves the afc0fce family root cause.

fixes.description: Add to the specialist prompt: 'For tasks involving payments-received-in-time-window, use show_transactions(direction=received), NOT show_received_payment_requests. The latter is for pending bills to approve/deny.'
fixes.rationale: Backup at execution time — catches the issue if the Explorer plan still picks the wrong API.

fixes.description: Clarify the boundary: show_social_feed returns FRIENDS' transactions (where neither party is you). show_transactions returns YOUR transactions (sent + received). Tasks about 'transactions involving X' usually need BOTH sources.
fixes.rationale: Already in the specialist prompt at a high level; tighten the disambiguation language.

fixes.description: Add to SEMANTIC API SELECTION: tasks about 'transactions involving <person>' should plan a UNION of show_transactions and show_social_feed; tasks restricted to 'social feed' use only the feed.
fixes.rationale: Plan-level fix is cleaner; specialist-level can be supplemental.

fixes.description: When the executor's code output contains 'No API named X', inject a strong recovery message that (a) names the active specialist's available APIs, (b) instructs the model to STOP guessing and re-read the specialist prompt's API list.
fixes.rationale: Mid-run intervention. Less invasive than catching it at plan time because the failure pattern is consistent: model invents one wrong name, gets the error, immediately invents another.

fixes.description: Add to each specialist prompt: 'If you get No API named X — STOP. The complete API list is above. Pick the closest match by name; do NOT guess new names.'
fixes.rationale: Prompt-only; relies on the model's instruction-following.

fixes.description: Add a 'NEVER fabricate data' rule: if a plan step asks you to use names/emails/IDs that you don't have, STOP and look them up via the appropriate app. Specifically forbid stock names (Alice/Bob) and example domains (@example.com).
fixes.rationale: The model fabricates when the plan has placeholders; this is a backstop in case E-PLAN-PLACEHOLDER fix doesn't land.

fixes.description: Document the bootstrap helpers explicitly in the executor system prompt: 'find_contact, login_to_app, fetch_all_pages, call_api are HELPERS, not APIs. NEVER call them via call_api(...).' Include a side-by-side example.
fixes.rationale: Currently the helpers are only listed in executor_helpers.py; the executor prompt assumes the model figures it out from usage.

fixes.description: Add to PhoneExecutor prompt: 'NEVER use search_contacts(query=YOUR_OWN_NAME) — that returns surname matches, not contacts of a relationship type. For group lookup ALWAYS use relationship=. For one-person lookup by name, use find_contact(name).'
fixes.rationale: Specialist prompt is the right surface — the model only writes this antipattern when it's already in the phone step.

fixes.description: Add a 'fail closed' rule: if a contact-resolution step returned an empty group OR if the filter set is unknown, DO NOT perform actions on the unfiltered superset. Call complete_task(answer=None) with an explanatory note instead.
fixes.rationale: Specialist-level; co-targets E-NO-FAIL-CLOSED.

fixes.description: Wrap call_api / fetch_all_pages with auto-retry-on-401: on a 401 response, automatically re-login the relevant app and retry once.
fixes.rationale: Helper-level fix; transparent to all specialists. Token expiry shouldn't be the model's problem.

fixes.description: Add a rule: 'If you get 401 token expired, IMMEDIATELY call login_to_app(<app>) and retry the failed call. Do NOT continue with the expired token.'
fixes.rationale: Prompt-only fallback if the helper change is too invasive.

fixes.description: Add an explicit id-table to the specialist prompt: payment_request_id is for approve/deny/update/delete payment requests; transaction_id is for like/comment/show_transaction. NEVER pass one as the other.
fixes.rationale: Specialist-level; addresses the symptom of E-WRONG-ENTITY at execution time.

fixes.description: Strengthen the paginated-API list in each specialist prompt and add 'ALWAYS use fetch_all_pages for these — call_api fetches ONLY the first 5 items'.
fixes.rationale: Lists exist in Venmo/Phone specialists; the issue is the model not consulting them. May need a concrete example showing the difference.

fixes.description: Make call_api auto-detect when it's being called on a known paginated API and warn (or auto-paginate). Hard to detect without an allow-list.
fixes.rationale: More invasive; risk of changing behavior on edge cases. Deprioritized.

fixes.description: Strip None-valued kwargs in call_api / fetch_all_pages before passing to the API. Optional params default correctly when omitted.
fixes.rationale: Helper-level fix is cleanest — every specialist benefits. Easy to implement with a dict comprehension.

fixes.description: Add a rule: 'NEVER pass None as an API kwarg value. Omit the kwarg entirely if you don't have a value.'
fixes.rationale: Prompt fallback if the helper change isn't taken.

fixes.description: Detect when two consecutive ReAct steps both produced errors with >70% code similarity. Inject a strong message: 'You just retried the same approach. Try a DIFFERENT API or read the prompt's pattern list.'
fixes.rationale: Mid-run intervention; the executor doesn't currently get any signal that it's looping.

fixes.description: For ACTION tasks, intercept complete_task(answer=None) calls if no action API (like_*, create_*, send_*, place_order, approve_*, deny_*) executed successfully in any step. Strip the call and inject 'You have not taken any action — continue executing the plan or explain why action is impossible.'
fixes.rationale: Sibling to the existing premature-complete_task guard but with an action-success requirement. Same code surface in base.py.

fixes.description: Add a rule: 'NEVER call complete_task on an ACTION task without at least one successful state-changing API call.'
fixes.rationale: Prompt-only first attempt. Cheaper but unreliable.
